messages:
lin: saw spike in provisional tokens from reconnecting toolcall path during canary test

ada: stats?

lin: aggregate: ~1.8k provisional charges over 4h, confirmed only ~37%. looks like retries are double-charging prefixes when session IDs rotate.

ops-bot: alert created ALERT-982 (provisional-charge-surge)

ada: dug into router logs. router issues new session_id on reconnect -> backend treats as fresh streaming toolcall; ledger records prefix tokens each time. snippet:
```
[2026-04-02T09:12:10Z] route=canary-qa session=new-xyz reconnect prev=old-abc path=/v1/toolrun provisional=3
[2026-04-02T09:12:10Z] header: User-Agent=healthcheck/1.2 x-forwarded-for=10.0.5.12
```

lin: this is the same class of problem as earlier ghost-prefix cases but with added noise from ALB probe config.

ada: quick mitigation ideas: propagate an `x-original-session-id` header from router -> sidecar so backend can dedupe provisional tokens on reconnect OR classify very-short sessions from known probe agents as non-billable.

billing-team: be careful: ignoring charges can create revenue leakage if misclassified. any rule needs an audit trail and refund/adjustment workflow.

lin: agreed. design thought: keep provisional ledger entries but tag them with `probe=true` and have reconciliation job mark refunds if confirmed rate < 5% after 24h. that way visibility retained.

console-team: from UX side — we need a new dashboard slice: "provisional->confirmed conversion" per route + "probe vs user traffic" breakdown to tune filters. also a toggle to include/exclude probe traffic in billing views.

ada: operational guard: only auto-ignore (i.e., issue refunds) after rollout when sampler detects >95% of sessions with `User-Agent=healthcheck` from configured IP set. rollout via feature-flag with gradual percent.

lin: implementation plan: (1) router: preserve original session id and set x-original-session-id when reconnects observed (2) backend: dedupe provisional charges when original id matches recent tombstone OR tag as probe if User-Agent matches probe list and duration <500ms (3) ledger: keep provisional entries, add tags and audit metadata (4) reconcile job: auto-refund low-confirmation groups and emit report.

ops-bot: created INFRA-812 (router header propagation), CONSOLE-209 (dashboard probe toggle), QA job q/streaming-retry-sim created

ada: QA test: run interleaved sim with 10% real client retries and 90% probe traffic; verify dedupe reduces double-charge rate by ~95% while maintaining >99% pass-through for real retries.

billing-team: we'll prepare an adjustments run for any invoices in the affected window. need a CSV export of provisional groups tagged `probe` for manual review before auto-refund.

console-team: we'll add histogram tiles for session durations and sample request traces for low-duration sessions so SREs can validate classification rules.

lin: one more caveat: some legitimate mobile clients have very short sessions due to poor connectivity. must whitelist known client agents so we don't over-refund.

ada: noted — plan includes client-agent allowlist and IP-range gating for probe auto-ignore.

lin: thanks all. I'll start the router patch and coordinate with QA and console for canary rollout tomorrow. :rocket:
